reason: The /demo classifieds portal is a stage prop that the ChirieSigură extension badges. Its hooks, data and copy rules are durable, and a future restyle must not break them. The episode rebuilt the portal and the brief fixed those rules, so no existing skill covers them.
Two listings shared photos, and the /demo page awaited searchParams outside Suspense. Both are portal-specific rules a future edit to this portal would otherwise break.
The portal skill's trigger missed listing-page and gallery work, which is where this episode's redesign happened, so the skill was loaded late or not at all.
The listing page was flagged as a blocking route in dev. The agent set instant=false with a rationale. Future sessions would otherwise "fix" the notice by moving the read and break the 404 behaviour.

Three distinct listing-page and tooling facts from this episode that a future portal edit would otherwise rediscover: the phone gallery CSS specificity trap, the scoped detector ignores, and the similar-listings clone filter.

The title-only filter let d1 and its d2 clone both appear as "similar" cards on other listings. The filter now also de-duplicates other titles, which supersedes the old one-line rule. Adds the map-tile load note.

A design review contradicted the results search band: the direction promised category/property-type filters that did not exist. The user wants the demo to pass as a live portal in a pitch, so each promised control must function or say plainly that it is off.

The finish review and user direction ("more soul, better looking, so it can look like a real portal") settled how the listing page should behave: no invented stats, no dead pagination, derived price per m², working share, and a mosaic that ends level with the price panel. These belong in the portal skill that governs the listing page.
Changing demo listing data broke no test in this session, but the verify API tests depend on the same data and are not named in the skill, so a future edit could miss them.

The results-card layout bug and the similar-card click rule were measured and fixed this episode. A future edit to the demo cards would otherwise reintroduce the flex-row gap. The skill is the one that was loaded for the demo work.

The user approved letting the landlord edit the d4 listing from the phone, so the portal's edit rules (allowed ids, fixed pitch listings, description element) belong with the portal skill for future sessions.
